title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Overview: fire, the Signature view
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature view of fire is respect: fire is the oldest engine and the oldest accident, and the difference is control. The Signature doctrine studies fire as a servant with strict terms of employment — contained, metered, monitored — and every Signature combustion record names the terms before the technique. These are original framings, labeled as such, in engineering framing only.
capabilities: Fire as servant with strict terms of employment
Contained, metered, monitored: the three terms
Terms named before technique, always
Original framings, honestly labeled

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature reaction doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature reaction doctrine reads every combustion equation as a promise and a price: the promise is the energy released, the price is the emissions and the risk. Balancing the equation is treated as moral bookkeeping — atoms in must equal atoms out, and anything unaccounted is a lie told to the future. The demo balances methane combustion and audits the atoms.
capabilities: Every equation as promise and price
Atom balancing as moral bookkeeping
Unaccounted atoms are lies to the future
Emissions named as part of the price

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature fuel doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature fuel doctrine grades fuels on the whole journey: extraction, transport, storage, burning, and cleanup — not just the flame. A fuel that burns clean but poisons its birthplace fails the doctrine. The doctrine's ledger has five columns, and every fuel record fills all five before any recommendation. The demo scores two fuels across the journey.
capabilities: Whole-journey grading: extraction to cleanup
Five-column ledger per fuel
Burning clean is not enough alone
No recommendations without full ledgers

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature engine doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature engine doctrine asks what the fire is for: work, and only work, justifies the risk. An engine is graded by how much of the fire's promise becomes motion and how little becomes waste heat, noise, and poison. The doctrine favors the engine that does its job and no more — right-sized, well-sealed, honestly rated. The demo grades two engines by promise-kept fraction.
capabilities: Fire justified only by work
Grading: promise turned to motion vs waste
Right-sized and honestly rated
Waste heat, noise, and poison counted

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature flame doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature flame doctrine studies the flame as a messenger: its color, shape, and sound report the mixture's health. A blue, quiet, steady flame reports a good mixture; yellow tips report richness; lifting reports too much air; roaring reports trouble. Operators are taught to read flames before reading gauges, because the flame reports first. The demo classifies flame reports.
capabilities: The flame as messenger of mixture health
Color, shape, sound as diagnostic channels
Read the flame before the gauge
Flame-reading taught to operators

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature safety doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature safety doctrine treats every fuel as guilty until proven contained: the default assumption is leak, and the system must prove otherwise continuously. Detection is layered — fixed sensors, portable checks, human noses trained and trusted — and the response to a positive is rehearsed, not improvised. The doctrine's measure is boring days: success is a year of nothing happening, logged and celebrated.
capabilities: Guilty until proven contained: assume leak
Layered detection: fixed, portable, human
Rehearsed responses, never improvised
Boring days as the measure of success

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature waste doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature waste doctrine follows the fire's leftovers: exhaust, ash, and heat must each have a destination planned before the first match. Waste heat is harvested where economical — co-generation, preheating, district warmth — and emissions are filtered, scrubbed, and accounted. A combustion system with no waste plan is, in the doctrine's phrase, half a system. The demo allocates waste streams to destinations.
capabilities: Every leftover gets a planned destination
Waste heat harvested where economical
Emissions filtered, scrubbed, accounted
No waste plan means half a system

title: The Combustion Science Signature Database — Signature future-fire doctrine
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature future-fire doctrine looks past burning things: where electricity can do the work, the doctrine prefers it — heat pumps over furnaces, motors over engines — and reserves fire for where it is still the honest answer. Hydrogen, biofuels, and synthetic fuels are graded by the five-column ledger, not by hype. The doctrine's direction is fewer flames, better used: the long arc bends toward the controlled fire becoming the rare fire.
capabilities: Prefer electricity where it honestly does the work
New fuels graded by ledger, not hype
Fewer flames, better used
The long arc toward the rare fire
